reply.text: {"say":"Leg day with no lunges or split squats, so the lower body leads with squat and hinge patterns and works the quads, hamstrings and glutes in a few different ways.","title":"Leg Day","days":[{"name":"Legs","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard before each rep."},{"key":"machine-leg-press","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full range without locking out."},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge at the hips, feel the hamstrings stretch."},{"key":"leg-extension-machine","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the top."},{"key":"seated-leg-curl-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":14,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the lowering phase."},{"key":"barbell-hip-thrust","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the top and squeeze glutes."},{"key":"standing-calf-raise-machine","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom."}]}],"unmet":[]}
